directive.exactQuestion: Does the 2026-09-21 Council Beta evidence introduce a materially new contradiction that reopens the already-resolved record-results-versus-reduced-alumina-guidance question?
directive.whyItMatters: The routing queue again assigns AA to Deep Resolver even though immutable Resolver evidence already adjudicated the same factual tension as compatible and non-blocking; repeating the same adjudication would violate anti-repeat.
directive.preferredEvidencePath: Compare AA-20260921T022537Z-council-beta.json with AA-20260919T073623Z-deep-resolver.json and the shared issuer Q2 2026 source.
directive.successCondition: Determine whether Beta supplied a materially different fact or methodology conflict; if not, preserve the prior resolved disposition and identify routing/reconciliation as the repeated blocker.

finding: Council Beta did not introduce a materially different contradiction. It restated that record financial results coexist with reduced alumina production guidance from operational instability, using the same issuer Q2 source already considered by Resolver. The facts remain compatible: favorable pricing/shipments can support strong financial results while refinery instability lowers alumina output/guidance. Operational instability remains material risk evidence, not an unresolved factual contradiction.
repeatedBlocker: Deterministic routing/reconciliation continues to emit unresolved_material_contradiction for AA after immutable Resolver evidence closed that exact contradiction.
failedStrategy: Repeated Resolver re-adjudication of the same record-results-versus-reduced-guidance tension.
changedStrategy: Do not re-litigate the unchanged factual question. Preserve the prior resolved disposition, classify the renewed Beta statement as materially similar rather than a new contradiction, and direct deterministic reconciliation to consume the existing Resolver disposition. Remaining source-integrity/company-underwriting gaps stay with Council Alpha.
recommendedDisposition: Remove Deep Resolver ownership for AA unless a future input signature introduces materially new conflicting evidence or Chief explicitly adjudicates otherwise.
